Metadata.title: Vay Đúng — Choose the right loan, or decide not to borrow
Metadata.description: See the real cost of a loan from licensed lenders, and know when not to borrow.

ok.title: The monthly payment is within the guideline
ok.body: Under the Vay Đúng guideline, total debt payments shouldn't exceed {limit} of your income each month. For you that's {max}. You already pay {debt}, leaving {headroom} for a new loan. This doesn't mean a lender will approve you.
ok.someOnly: Only some options below are within this level. Check the note on each option.

depends.title: This may be too much, depending on the rate you get
depends.body: Under the Vay Đúng guideline, total debt payments shouldn't exceed {limit} of your income each month. For you that's {max}. You already pay {debt}, leaving {headroom} for a new loan. At the lowest rate this could fit, but at higher rates it goes over. Ask for the exact monthly payment before you sign.
depends.noOffers: Under the Vay Đúng guideline, total debt payments shouldn't exceed {limit} of your income each month. For you that's {max}. You already pay {debt}, leaving {headroom} for a new loan. We couldn't find a suitable product to cost this loan.

too_much.title: We don't recommend borrowing this amount
too_much.body: Under the Vay Đúng guideline, total debt payments shouldn't exceed {limit} of your income each month. For you that's {max}. You already pay {debt}, leaving only {headroom} for a new loan. The principal alone would be about {principalOnly} a month, before interest.

too_much_with_interest.body: Under the Vay Đúng guideline, total debt payments shouldn't exceed {limit} of your income each month. For you that's {max}. You already pay {debt}, leaving only {headroom} for a new loan. Even at the lowest rate we found, this loan needs about {lowestPayment} a month.

no_income.title: We don't recommend borrowing without a regular income
no_income.body: A loan has to be repaid every month, even before you find work. Paying late adds more interest and can damage your credit history.

no_data.body: Under the Vay Đúng guideline, total debt payments shouldn't exceed {limit} of your income each month. For you that's {max}. You already pay {debt}, leaving {headroom} for a new loan. The principal alone is about {principalOnly} a month, before interest.

Alternatives.title: What you could do instead
Alternatives.smaller: Borrow less: about {amount} over {term} months could fit (estimate at {lender}'s highest rate).
Alternatives.longer: Repay over a longer time: the monthly payment falls, but the total cost rises.
Alternatives.payDebt: Pay down your current debts before borrowing more.
Alternatives.save: Save part of it first, then borrow less or not at all.
Alternatives.family: Ask family, or ask your employer about a salary advance.
Alternatives.avoid: Don't turn to loan sharks or loan apps of unknown origin. If you're asked to transfer money before receiving a loan, stop and check with the lender's official hotline.
Alternatives.familyNoIncome: Ask family whether they can help for now.

Guidance.title: What to know for this need
Guidance.phone: Buying electronics: ask about installments at the store first. If a plan is advertised as 0%, ask whether any fees or insurance come with it. If none do, it can be cheaper than a cash loan. Compare the total you'd pay.
Guidance.motorbike: Buying a motorbike: compare dealer installments with a cash loan. Some installment loans use the bike as security or set conditions on its registration papers, so ask before signing. The total you'd pay is the number to compare.
Guidance.education: Tuition: first ask about scholarships and paying in stages. If you're a student in difficult circumstances, ask your school or the Vietnam Bank for Social Policies about its student loan programme and whether you qualify.
Guidance.medical: An emergency: check your health insurance and ask family first. If you still need to borrow, use only a licensed lender, even in a hurry.
Guidance.debt: Borrowing to pay debt: be careful, debts can snowball. First ask your current lender about more time or a new repayment schedule. Only take a new loan if its real cost is clearly lower than the old one.
Guidance.living: Borrowing for everyday spending: the loan raises your monthly payments while your income stays the same. See whether you can cut spending or get a salary advance first.
Guidance.other: A cash loan is flexible but can be expensive. Borrow only what you need, and compare the total you'd pay across the options below.
Guidance.urgent: In a hurry: people who need money fast are easier to scam. Be wary if anyone makes you transfer money first, especially to a personal account, before approving or paying out a loan. A genuine fee or insurance charge must be written in the contract. Call the lender's official hotline before transferring anything.

Results.title: Your results
Results.offersTitle: Your options, ordered by estimated real rate
Results.offersTitleTooMuch: Costs for reference, if you're still considering it
Results.noOffers: There's no product to compare for your answers right now. See the reasons in the sections below.
Results.insufficientIntro: These products aren't compared yet because we don't have enough reliable information to work out your cost. Each item gives the reason. This doesn't mean a product is good or bad.
Results.staleReason: The data is over 90 days old and needs re-checking.
Results.why1: We order by Vay Đúng's estimated real rate, at the highest level the lender publishes, because nobody knows yet which rate you'd get. It includes mandatory fees with a known amount, but not insurance that is optional or may not be required. This order isn't advice on which lender to choose.
Results.why2: A product whose fees are all unknown can't be first, because its real cost may be higher than we can calculate.
Results.why3: No lender pays to be ranked higher. Vay Đúng takes no commission and doesn't sell your information.
Results.why4: We only list lenders on the State Bank of Vietnam's lists (as of {date}):
Results.disclaimer: This is information and calculation for your reference, not financial advice, credit advice or brokerage. Vay Đúng doesn't lend and doesn't guarantee approval. The figures are our estimates, based on lenders' public pages on the date shown, and may have changed. The official rate and fees are those in your contract. Read it carefully before signing.

reasons.amount_too_low: The amount is below the minimum ({value}).
reasons.amount_too_high: The amount is above the maximum ({value}).
reasons.over_finance_company_cap: For now we don't show amounts above 100 million đồng at finance companies. Circular 43/2016/TT-NHNN mentions this level for consumer loans, and we're awaiting legal confirmation. This isn't a comment on the lender's product. You can ask them directly.
reasons.term_too_short: The term is below the minimum ({value} months).
reasons.term_too_long: The term is above the maximum ({value} months).
reasons.income_too_low: Requires income of {value} a month or more.
reasons.too_old_at_end: Requires age {value} or under by the time the loan is repaid.

Results.disclaimerShort: These are estimates for reference, not financial advice, and don't guarantee approval. The official figures are those in your contract.

exclude.secondary_sources: We only found figures in general articles, not on an official product page or contract.
exclude.lender_unverified: We haven't been able to verify the lender named in this product's contract.
exclude.unverified: We haven't been able to verify this product and its terms on an official page.
exclude.rate_varies: The rate varies widely by programme or the source is old, so we can't work out a rate for you.
exclude.ceiling_only: We only found a rate ceiling, not an offered rate.
exclude.floor_only: We only found a "from X%" figure, not an offered range.
exclude.no_rate: We haven't found a published rate for this product.

Offer.sentence: You borrow {amount} and repay {total} in total over {term} months.
Offer.cost: Cost of the loan (total paid minus money received)
Offer.realAprNote: includes mandatory fees with a known amount; excludes items listed separately below
Offer.assumption: assumption: worked out from the lender's example, as the interest method isn't stated; the contract will state the equivalent reducing-balance rate
Offer.repaymentAssumption: The way the principal is repaid is our assumption, worked out from the lender's example.

fit.fits: Within the guideline, even at the highest published rate
fit.fits_only_low: Only within the guideline at a low rate

Offer.lowConfidence: Low confidence: this product's figures come from sources that are unclear or don't match. Check with the lender.
Offer.feesUnknown: Fees unknown: the real cost may be higher
Offer.conflict: The lender's pages give different figures for some items. We prefer the product page; if sources of the same type differ, we use the figure less favourable to you. Check with the lender before signing.
Offer.feesPartial: There may be other unpublished fees.
Offer.insuranceOptional: {name}: optional according to the lender's source. If you buy it: about {min}–{max}, and the loan would cost up to about {cost}.
Offer.insuranceUnclear: {name}: the source doesn't say whether it's required, so ask. If it applies: about {min}–{max}. If it's deducted from the payout, the loan would cost up to about {cost}. If it's added to the loan, your monthly payment will be higher.
Offer.feeGreater: the higher of {percent}% of the principal still owed and all remaining interest
Offer.effective: Rate including interest on interest over a year
Offer.existingCustomer: You must already be a customer of this lender.
Offer.incomeProofNote: This product may need proof of income. Ask first whether the way you're paid is accepted.
Offer.licensed: On the State Bank of Vietnam's list
Offer.unknownLimits: It's unclear whether this product covers your chosen amount or term.
Offer.insuranceOptionalUnknownCollection: {name}: optional according to the lender's source. If you buy it: about {min}–{max}. If it's deducted from the payout, the loan would cost up to about {cost}. If it's added to the loan, your monthly payment will be higher.
Offer.insuranceMandatoryAssumed: Mandatory insurance is calculated as if deducted from the payout, because the source doesn't say.
